example.name: Example traveller
example.description: The request from the project brief: budget EUR 50, morning departure, at most 1 transfer, changeable ticket required.

budget.name: Budget traveller
budget.description: Wants the cheapest acceptable trip; accepts long journeys and any departure time, dislikes changing buses.

business.name: Business traveller
business.description: Must arrive the same day for afternoon meetings: early departure, direct, changeable, at most 8 hours. Price matters little.

flexible_tourist.name: Flexibility-focused tourist
flexible_tourist.description: Plans may change, so a changeable and refundable fare matters most; prefers an afternoon departure and a well-rated company.

eco.name: Environment-focused traveller
eco.description: Chooses the lowest-emission option within a moderate budget; departure time is unimportant.
